FY1.title: Physics as a natural science
tavoitteet: becomes familiar with physics as a systematic science based on experiments
becomes familiar with the scales of matter and of the universe
becomes familiar with the methods used to gather information in physics
can plan and carry out simple scientific experiments
gains experiences that awaken and deepen an interest in physics and in studying it

FY2.title: Physics, environment and society
tavoitteet: becomes familiar with energy as a central concept of physics
knows different forms of energy and ways of producing energy
can compare the orders of magnitude of different ways of producing energy and their environmental effects
gains the skills to take part in discussion and decision-making about the environment and technology from the point of view of a sustainable energy economy

lessons.fy2-5: Fuels and heat of combustion E = Hm
lessons.fy2-6: Ways of producing energy and how they compare
lessons.fy2-8: Energy production, the environment and climate change

FY3.title: Energy and heat
tavoitteet: deepens their understanding of energy as a central concept of physics
can investigate phenomena related to the thermodynamic state of matter and to changes of state
can apply the concepts and models of thermodynamics when examining energy production solutions and building a sustainable future
recognises the importance of energy balance and heat transfer in climate change

FY4.title: Force and motion
tavoitteet: can investigate phenomena related to force and motion experimentally
can produce and analyse graphs of measurement data

knows safety aspects related to force and motion
